title: Fix data_guard reverting clean_commands.py's slash-command pruning (self_check #13 regression)
plan: Re-run clean_commands; stop data_guard from restoring commands.json to its pre-cleanup snapshot; gate process_video.py's ungated append with the same slash-token filter.

notes.text: Root cause confirmed via git history (single revert commit 65min after fire 94): data_guard's 55%-floor anti-collapse restore doesn't distinguish deliberate quarantine-based pruning from accidental data loss. Fixed by re-baselining the snapshot in clean_commands.py; also gated a second ungated writer (process_video.py) that fire 94 missed.

outcome: self_check #13 fixed (44/50 -> 45/50), data_guard reports commands.json healthy (not RESTORED) after re-running the cleanup, guardrails 18/20 unchanged, excava_core_test all pass. Root cause closed, not just the symptom.
